entries.subject: Lucy L’LORRI photographs as a photographic lens
entries.finding: The displayed shape is an authored reconstruction, not the mission photogrammetric model, and no photograph is registered to it. The unmerged feat/lucy-dinkinesh-surfaces branch adds a recovered numerical shape whose frame and image registration remain unqualified.
entries.revisitWhen: A mission-derived shape with a documented body frame, and a joint orientation and camera registration that passes interior holdouts from a different viewing direction.
